measure_description: Measured with Powercalc Measure on a setup of 8 large and 14 small Shapes panels plus the controller (firmware 12.4.1). Values are for the whole set, not per panel. At brightness 1 the controller sometimes drops into a low-power state (about 1.8 W instead of about 7.5 W), so that row alternates between the two levels.
name: Shapes
